title: Leaderboard Incentives: Model Rankings under Strategic Post-Training

c1.basis: An exhaustive Z3 partition covers every nonnegative effort profile in an exact two-player continuous game and proves that no PNE exists.

c2.basis: An exact PNE satisfying the written assumptions strictly reverses capability order because the permitted convex cost is flat on a positive interval.

c3.basis: The just-overtake inequality holds, yet an exact nonzero PNE exists under the same paper-admissible flat cost.

c4.basis: Two distinct nonzero PNE persist at every TbT level under the written assumptions; the narrower conditional statement of Proposition 5.3 is explicitly separated.

c5.basis: A generalized-logit family satisfying the displayed conditions has required catch-up effort exactly one for all TbT levels, so a finite stabilizing threshold need not exist.

c6.basis: The hashed source vector reconstructs 384667.5595, which rounds to 384668, but the source omits raw Winogrande measurements, fit parameters, training code, and checkpoints.
